sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive leadership remains firmly entrenched as Consumer Defensive and Healthcare dominate multi-timeframe strength while cyclical and tech groups lose ground.

Market breadth is heavily concentrated, with only 2 of 11 sectors exhibiting all-green performance across all horizons (week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD). Capital continues to anchor in low-beta areas, led by Consumer Defensive (0.933 momentum) and Healthcare (0.900 momentum), both sustaining top-3 rankings across 1-, 3-, and 6-month periods.

Meanwhile, growth and cyclicals are fading over the short term. Technology, Industrials, and Basic Materials each slipped 1 spot over the last 5 sessions, leaving cyclical and growth momentum subdued. Financials, Real Estate, and Utilities captured minor 1-spot rank improvements, reflecting an incremental rotation toward yield and rate-sensitive pockets beneath the defensive core.

## Strength
- **Narrow All-Green Breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors—Consumer Defensive and Healthcare—are positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD frames.
- **Sustained Leadership:** Consumer Defensive (rank 2 YTD) and Healthcare (rank 3 YTD) maintain their sustained strong posture, holding top-3 positions across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Defensive Dominance:** Consumer Defensive leads the market with a 0.933 momentum score, followed closely by Healthcare at 0.900.

## Movers & Momentum
- **5-Session Advancers:** Financials (+1 spot to rank 6, 0.517 momentum), Real Estate (+1 spot to rank 4, 0.600 momentum), and Utilities (+1 spot to rank 8, 0.467 momentum) posted the sole ranking gains over the past week.
- **Cyclical Slips:** Technology (-1 to rank 5, 0.300 momentum), Industrials (-1 to rank 7, 0.350 momentum), and Basic Materials (-1 to rank 9, 0.183 momentum) were the sole decliners over the 5-session window.
- **Momentum Anchors:** Energy holds the top YTD rank (rank 1) with moderate 0.567 momentum, while Communication Services languishes at the bottom of the table (rank 11 YTD, 0.167 momentum).

## Divergences
- **Energy Rank vs. Momentum:** Energy holds the #1 YTD rank despite a modest 0.567 momentum score, trailing both Consumer Defensive (0.933) and Healthcare (0.900).
- **Lagging Growth Profiles:** Technology retains an upper-half ranking (rank 5 YTD) despite weak momentum (0.300), underscoring an ongoing disconnect between full-year standing and recent velocity.
- **No Fragile Leaders:** No sectors triggered the fragile all-green early-warning indicator, indicating that the prevailing all-green leadership (Consumer Defensive and Healthcare) remains stable.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Consumer retail and insurance groups are driving market leadership, while basic materials and precious metals suffer steep short-term deteriorations.

Leadership is anchored by defensive retail and healthcare, with Discount Stores (0.917 momentum) and Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (0.889 momentum) topping the momentum board. Broad retail is rotating higher rapidly, evidenced by sharp 5-day rank gains in Department Stores (+26) and Apparel Retail (+20), even as sustained performers like Insurance Brokers (+18) and Drug Manufacturers - General (0.865 momentum) maintain upward trajectories.

Conversely, metals and mining are experiencing severe capital flight. Copper plunged 43 spots (rank 98, 0.21 momentum), with significant declines also hitting Gold (-19 spots to rank 120), Silver (-16 spots to rank 132), and Other Industrial Metals & Mining (-20 spots to rank 102). Bottom-tier momentum remains severely depressed across energy transition and commodities, led lower by Uranium (0.021) and Solar (0.028).

## Strength
- **Narrow all-green breadth:** Only 15 of 144 industry groups are positive across all time horizons (week, month, quarter, half, YTD), anchored by Discount Stores (0.917 momentum) and Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (0.889 momentum).
- **Insurance stability:** Insurance - Reinsurance (0.881 momentum), Insurance Brokers (0.79 momentum), and Insurance - Property & Casualty (0.79 momentum) are all-green, with Brokers jumping 18 spots to rank 63.
- **Sustained leadership:** Groups demonstrating top-36 ranks across 1, 3, and 6 months include Drug Manufacturers - General, Medical Distribution, Lodging, and Security & Protection Services.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Retail resurgence:** Department Stores surged 26 spots to rank 66 (0.70 momentum), Apparel Retail climbed 20 spots to rank 94 (0.55 momentum), and Apparel Manufacturing added 16 spots to rank 58 (0.74 momentum).
- **Severe pullbacks:** Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries dropped 57 spots to rank 97, Healthcare Plans fell 29 spots to rank 54, and Chemicals retreated 20 spots to rank 38.
- **Lagging momentum:** Uranium (0.021), Solar (0.028), Other Precious Metals & Mining (0.033), and Gambling (0.070) sit at the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Divergences
- **Fading strength:** Despite high absolute momentum, short-term rank slippage has emerged in Lodging (0.81 momentum, -1 spot), Insurance - Diversified (0.76 momentum, -1 spot), Medical Care Facilities (0.69 momentum, -2 spots), and Industrial Distribution (0.62 momentum, -5 spots).
- **Emerging bottom-movers:** Rank gains are outpacing momentum scores in Building Materials (+6 spots, 0.49 momentum), Real Estate Services (+6 spots, 0.47 momentum), Building Products & Equipment (+7 spots, 0.44 momentum), REIT - Diversified (+5 spots, 0.44 momentum), and Information Technology Services (+5 spots, 0.42 momentum).
